Placing manufacturing in the secondary sector is the definitional statement in 23998 - processing raw materials into more valuable goods, as distinct from primary extraction and tertiary services.

Pollution as the negative effect of industrialisation, against economic growth, foreign exchange and urbanisation. 24016 is the concept enumerating industrial pollution; 24017/24018 are the controls, which this item does not ask about.
